hits.title: This is my (rather lengthy) interview with Mike, a happily retired LGS owner who had an extraordinary career in comic books and Magic cards. He set up shop in ‘94, qualified for the MtG Pro Tour 13 times, and retired in his 40s with a multimillion-dollar card collection. Good luck doing that today!
